severity_policy: Engineering triage under stated conditions; no claim that risk manifested in deployment.

risks.title: Hardware-capable HTTP routes lack authentication
risks.finding: Delegated P&P/centring writes and lifter control routes can invoke hardware without requireAuth or machineOp gate.
risks.conditions: A client can reach API listener; downstream hardware checks still apply.
risks.limitations: Network exposure/firewall and real actuation were not tested.

risks.title: Vision unavailable can produce an overall PASS
risks.finding: Inspection converts camera-unavailable HTTP/tool failures into skipped checkpoint; queue assigns PASS for completed sequence.
risks.conditions: Classifier recognizes upstream camera condition while other cycle steps succeed.
risks.limitations: Business acceptance policy unknown; no inspection exercised.

risks.title: Reference catalog writes are not role gated
risks.finding: POST/PATCH/DELETE references use optionalAuth without requireAuth or machine-operation/tab denial. Delete can also remove remote vision resources.
risks.conditions: API reachable regardless of require_login value.
risks.limitations: Frontend navigation restrictions do not establish backend protection; deployment scope unknown.

risks.title: Settings encryption has fixed fallback key
risks.finding: Credential encryption key resolves environment secret variables, else a source constant; persistent cookie key is separate.
risks.conditions: Neither SETTINGS_SECRETS_KEY nor SESSION_SECRET environment value exists.
risks.limitations: Secret values were excluded; effective environment not inspected.

risks.title: Maintenance timeout does not cancel output command
risks.finding: Promise.race marks UI timeout after10s but does not abort runHardwareTest; late server completion remains possible.
risks.conditions: Hardware or bridge request lasts more than10s.
risks.limitations: Late completion not observed; backend safety behavior must be evaluated separately.

risks.title: Pick-and-place firmware source is a nonoperational stub
risks.finding: Unused command dispatcher; setup only Serial.begin and loop delay; no TCP, sensing or motor implementation. Master sends MOVEAMMT2 absent here.
risks.conditions: Future firmware build/change assumes checked-in sketch represents deployed P&P controller.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Obtain real firmware source/build provenance and compare deployed command schema before firmware changes.

risks.title: Pick-and-place software stop shares blocked command queue
risks.finding: STOP and ESTOP enqueue through sendCommand while motion holds same chain awaiting DONE; software stop latency can equal remaining transaction wait.
risks.conditions: A motion request is waiting for DONE when STOP/ESTOP is requested.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Add delayed-DONE transport test and design explicit interrupt path; physical E-stop performance unverified.

risks.title: EtherCAT OP maintainer startup races initialization flag
risks.finding: Thread starts before is_initialized true; worker loop requires flag and can exit immediately while op_maintainer_running remains true.
risks.conditions: Worker thread runs before init assigns is_initialized=true.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Use fake pysoem and deterministic scheduler to verify worker starts after initialization and remains alive.

risks.title: EtherCAT selected slave not retained by runtime I/O
risks.finding: Init selects named target position, runtime I/O and maintainer always use index zero; mismatch with multi-slave bus.
risks.conditions: Selected named slave is not bus index zero.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Persist selected slave index and verify writes/reads against a multi-slave fake.

risks.title: Centring jog default conflicts with production serial target
risks.finding: send_jog defaults ttyUSB2; production upload uses /dev/centring and comments identify ttyUSB2 as another board. Actual wiring was not queried.
risks.conditions: Diagnostic launched with default device path; actual mapping not verified.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction. Actual wiring/device identity not inspected.
risks.suggested_followup: Require explicit verified device path before any future jog; align defaults separately.

risks.title: Launch wrappers supply accepted shared session signing fallbacks
risks.finding: When no real SESSION_SECRET override is provided, launcher fallback strings satisfy minimum length and differ from the single banned legacy placeholder. Resolver accepts the fixed source-controlled signing values instead of generating a unique secret. Values deliberately not reproduced.
risks.conditions: Launcher is used without a caller-provided SESSION_SECRET override.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Remove fixed launcher fallbacks and use the persistent random-secret path or securely provision a unique override; review active deployment separately.

risks.title: Built-in user changes overwritten on startup
risks.finding: Startup upserts username, role, active state and password hash for each seed account.
risks.conditions: Edited account ID matches configured seed.
risks.limitations: Seed credential file excluded; actual accounts unknown.

risks.title: Settings writes can partially commit
risks.finding: Flat patches/imports commit each domain separately; cache/mirror/runtime hooks run after domain transaction.
risks.conditions: Later domain validation/hook/mirror fails after an earlier domain commits.
risks.limitations: No fault injection executed; rollback not globally implemented in inspected function.

risks.title: Backup path boundary uses string prefix
risks.finding: readBackupFile permits prefix matches against data directory and does not resolve symlinks.
risks.conditions: Admin restore requests path in similarly prefixed sibling or symlink; target readable JSON/package.
risks.limitations: Exploitability depends filesystem placement and package validation; no filesystem probing.

risks.title: Short time-derived catalog IDs can collide
risks.finding: Reference/tube identifiers use last six decimal timestamp digits.
risks.conditions: Creation timestamps equal modulo1,000,000ms; existing primary key remains.
risks.limitations: Collision not observed; SQL PK prevents duplicate row but request can fail.

risks.title: History writes are best effort
risks.finding: recordProductionRun/recordError catch persistence errors and return null; job success does not depend on durable audit.
risks.conditions: SQLite IO/lock/schema error during terminal outcome recording.
risks.limitations: No durability test; no claim of existing missing records.

risks.title: User patch can partially update before rejecting a later field
risks.finding: PATCH user updates username/id_number before rejecting invalid role; no enclosing transaction.
risks.conditions: One request combines accepted early field with disallowed later role.
risks.limitations: Confirmed control-flow ordering; not executed.

risks.title: DB-only vision secrets appear disconnected from runtime resolution
risks.finding: readSystemSettings returns assembled view without raw secrets; resolveVisionConfig checks body/settings/env, not settingsService.loadSecrets.
risks.conditions: Key stored only in settings_secrets, absent request and environment.
risks.limitations: INFERRED functional impact; remote service may not enforce keys.

risks.title: Background debug telemetry in operational paths
risks.finding: Machine/production/health code makes unconditional loopback fetches and some modules append debug files.
risks.conditions: Operational path invoked; localhost logger may be absent.
risks.limitations: Receivers/runtime overhead unknown; source not transmitted by audit.

risks.title: Software stop timeout does not prove motion cancellation
risks.finding: Abort uses Promise.race on serialized controller commands; centring stop waits idle rather than wire STOP.
risks.conditions: Motion already pending when stop requested.
risks.limitations: Physical safety handled separately; hardware agent documents actual firmware boundary.

risks.title: Supervisor polls may overlap
risks.finding: setInterval starts async tick without in-flight guard; runTcpHealthPoll sequentially awaits vision and both device health checks.
risks.conditions: Probe duration exceeds configured interval.
risks.limitations: INFERRED scheduling overlap; device command serializers may mitigate wire concurrency.

risks.title: External live-feed reconnect can accumulate listeners
risks.finding: Each onConnect calls subscribeLiveFeed which adds live_frame/frame_data listeners; disconnect callback clears frame without removing those listeners. Existing connected singleton also skips newly supplied callbacks.
risks.conditions: Reconnect while live preview remains mounted, or concurrent consumers reuse connected singleton.
risks.limitations: No runtime reconnect reproduction; normal unmount cleanup removes listeners.

risks.title: Local counters are not authoritative production totals
risks.finding: Counters persist localStorage while job deduplication is MainPage mount-local; updates require observing a result and multiple tabs do not coordinate counter writes.
risks.conditions: Production occurs while MainPage absent, reload/navigation between job observations, or multiple browser tabs update totals.
risks.limitations: No observed loss/duplication; exact effects depend job lifecycle; SQLite history is separate.

risks.title: Missing optional desktop host limits system controls
risks.finding: 23 ipcClient operations reference optional electronAPI; no corresponding Electron host implementation in inspected first-party source. Browser clock set returns success without modifying host; USB observer always reports disconnected.
risks.conditions: Browser-only deployment without separately supplied Electron bridge.
risks.limitations: An external desktop host could implement the interface; current running host was not inspected.

risks.title: Machine poll responses can overlap
risks.finding: 250ms interval launches refresh promises without in-flight suppression or monotonic snapshot version check.
risks.conditions: Round-trip exceeds250ms; later-started request finishes first.
risks.limitations: Runtime latency/races unverified.

risks.title: Infrastructure HTTP failure can display inspection FAIL
risks.finding: Vision non-OK responses are normalized as FAIL while thrown network errors become UNKNOWN.
risks.conditions: Vision HTTP proxy/remote responds non-OK during interactive inspection.
risks.limitations: Documented UI semantic risk; not a claim backend production traceability uses this path.

risks.title: Generic system-domain reader hits incompatible facade response
risks.finding: getDomain('system') expects response.data, but earlier fixed GET /api/settings/system returns response.settings. The system domain is registered, so this is a valid-domain route precedence conflict.
risks.conditions: An API consumer invokes exported getDomain with domain 'system'.
risks.limitations: No active frontend caller of getDomain detected; no request executed.

risks.title: Centring reconnect contract contradicts executable behavior
risks.finding: Executable loop aborts running motion on peer death/replacement/keepalive timeout; headers claim reconnect preserves motion.
risks.conditions: Host relies on comments claiming motion survives reconnect.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Align documentation and host reconnection assumptions to code, then validate failure handling.

risks.title: Centring hardware test uses removed commands
risks.finding: --calibrate family expects CALIBRATE/CALIBRATION/SETHENDS absent from current firmware table. smoke-only still mutates offset and clears E-stop.
risks.conditions: Legacy calibration flags or smoke-only diagnostics run against current V2 source.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Reconcile suite with current V2 protocol before live use; isolate tests by side effect.

risks.title: Centring completion can report accepted OK despite timeout/stuck release
risks.finding: Stuck HOME release restores start/deactivates axis then can finish Ok; timeout completion emits accepted=true reason=ok with moveEnd=timeout.
risks.conditions: HOME release switch sticks or movement times out and caller accepts only accepted/reason fields.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Assert moveEnd and switch sequence in host acceptance/tests; do not use accepted alone.

risks.title: EtherCAT WKC and raw AL checks have differing health semantics
risks.finding: AL display masks flags while comparisons use raw state; WKC mismatch deliberately returns ok with warning.
risks.conditions: WKC differs from expected or AL error flag is set.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Test explicit flagged-state/WKC scenarios and confirm policy fits production failure handling.

risks.title: Firmware compile hook mutates shared PlatformIO framework
risks.finding: Compile hook rewrites libdeps, compiled Arduino archive and shared framework IPAddress.cpp.
risks.conditions: PlatformIO compile invokes flash_opt hook in a shared toolchain.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Build in dedicated toolchain/cache or explicitly account for these mutations.

risks.title: Mocked pick-and-place operations still emit debug network and file writes
risks.finding: Unconditional localhost ingest and absolute .cursor log append remain when hardware sessions are mocked.
risks.conditions: Mocked or real P&P commands reach unconditional debug logging.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Control debug transport/files in tests and runtime configuration.

risks.title: Test names conceal active device operations
risks.finding: Motor diagnostic clears outputs and default calibration emits pulses; limits-only configures bus. Production soak defaults100 cycles and setup recovery.
risks.conditions: Generic test discovery executes diagnostic or soak scripts.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Keep live scripts out of generic test runner; require isolated machine workflow.

risks.title: Boot deployment depends on unpinned external installer
risks.finding: Clones/pulls theme repository and executes install_theme.sh as root without commit pin.
risks.conditions: Provisioning installer retrieves current external repository and runs its installer.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Record reviewed external revision and host rollback before provisioning.

risks.title: Startup and proxy port settings can diverge
risks.finding: PORT conflict setting does not change hardcoded manual health/proxy3333; boot sources .env again in child after PORT export.
risks.conditions: Nondefault API port/overrides are selected.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Test nondefault ports and align health/proxy/application precedence.

risks.title: Move timeout recovery may accept weak completion evidence
risks.finding: recoverMoveAtTarget ignores waitIdle failure, checks final fault and reference-axis position tolerance, without independently asserting busy=false or all-axis target.
risks.conditions: DONE is lost/late and timeout-recovery fallback checks position while busy/other-axis status may differ.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Test delayed/lost DONE with busy/fault and mismatched non-reference axis before accepting completion.

risks.title: Host provisioning scripts have broad filesystem/security effects
risks.finding: Keyring suppression removes backed-up keyring files and changes PAM/D-Bus; permission setup can grant capabilities to shared system Python.
risks.conditions: Host provisioning helper executes against shared system configuration.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Review as separate host provisioning change, not application-only deployment.

risks.title: Frontend mapping test duplicates implementation
risks.finding: Node test defines its own selectedOptionsFromVisionChecks instead of importing production TS function.
risks.conditions: Production mapping changes independently of copied test implementation.
risks.limitations: Tests were not run; two assertions only validate copied mapping.

risks.title: History pagination drops displayed search/date filters
risks.finding: HistoryView.buildFilters includes only limit/offset/current overrides, so pagination omits previously applied date/search; filter controls remain set. Changing one filter also omits the other.
risks.conditions: Operator applies date/search then pages, or combines date and search.
risks.limitations: No browser reproduction; ErrorHistoryView preserves its filters and is not affected by this source pattern.

risks.title: Root and scripts vision clients drift
risks.finding: Root client health-only ping differs from script client health/remote-info fallback; wrapper chooses scripts copy.
risks.conditions: Caller selects a different copied vision CLI.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Consolidate entrypoint or make divergence explicit.

risks.title: Pick-and-place mock teardown may wait for persistent connections
risks.finding: Mock server.close does not explicitly close accepted sockets; persistent client may keep shutdown waiting.
risks.conditions: Mock close begins with accepted sockets still alive.
risks.limitations: Static source only; no runtime, hardware, security or scheduling reproduction.
risks.suggested_followup: Ensure tests disconnect master and destroy tracked sockets in finally; no hang reproduced.

risks.title: Declared grant-admin script target is absent
risks.finding: backend package declares scripts/grant-admin-access.mjs but no source file exists at that path; frontend/server forwarding does not supply it.
risks.conditions: Operator invokes declared grant-admin helper.
risks.limitations: Static path resolution only; command not executed.
